title: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Space, a collaborative hub for shared pages and files, available on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans; it replaces Library (Kris Holt/Engadget)
summary: Kris Holt / Engadget: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Space, a collaborative hub for shared pages and files, available on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans; it replaces Library — ChatGPT is coming to Slack and Microsoft Teams too. — OpenAI unveiled several work-related tools at its Dev Day event today, including a hub designed for collaboration.
